newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Antwerp airport air cargo down 8.55 pecent in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Antwerp airport air cargo down 8.55 pecent in 1996.

text.p: Antwerp airport saw a decline in freight tonnage last year, compared to 1995, an airport statement showed.
For 1996 the figures were as follows:

Passenger numbers at the Belgian airport have shown a continual increase over the last five years. Last year was no exception when the number of passengers grew by 4.61 percent on 1995 whilst movements rose by 6.17 percent on 1995 levels.

However, freight volumes have shown a slight decline falling by 8.55 percent to 9,883 tonnes in 1996, compared to the total tonnage for 1995 when cargo growth was an exceptional levels with a 383 percent increase on 1994 freight volumes.
An airport spokesman, commenting on last year's decline, said: "Antwerp is a very small airport, losing one contract from a shipper can make a difference."
Scheduled carriers calling at the Belgian airport include, BA Express, KLM, Sabena and VLM. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
